Presenting EK DUJHE PE MARNE WALE NAHI KISI SE DARNE WALE FULL VIDEO SONG from Aatank Hi Aatank movie starring Rajinikanth, Aamir Khan and Juhi Chawla in lead roles, released in 1995. The song is sung by ALKA YAGNIK, BAPPI LAHIRI and music is given by BAPPI LAHIRI music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: EK DUJHE PE MARNE WALE NAHI KISI SE DARNE WALE
Singers: ALKA YAGNIK, BAPPI LAHIRI
Music Director: BAPPI LAHIRI
When the film was originally announced (as Aatank) it starred Sunny Deol and 'Rajnikant' in lead roles.
